cases.name: Road vehicle run: closed forms and a straight run
cases.result: A car run straight for 40 m has no steering and sweeps its width times its length; a tractor and semitrailer gives one body per unit; a bad vehicle, a bad path and a path of one point are refused with a reason (bin/test-sweptpath.mjs)

cases.name: Aircraft on a circle against the closed form
cases.result: On a 60 m circle the outer wing tip runs on sqrt((r + span/2)^2 + ahead^2) and the inner one likewise, within 0.05 m, and the nose gear steers atan(wheelbase / main gear radius) to six decimals; a 12.6 m circle needs more than the 78 degree lock and is flagged; pushback runs (bin/test-sweptpath.mjs)

cases.name: Light rail car on a circle against the chord geometry
cases.result: On a 60 m curve the body middle sits at sqrt(R^2 - (bogie centres/2)^2) and the outer end corner at sqrt((r + w/2)^2 + (b/2 + overhang)^2), within 0.01 m; two coupled cars stand one car pitch apart (bin/test-sweptpath.mjs)

cases.name: Clearance finds the first hit and respects the margin
cases.result: A wall across a 40 m run is first hit where the bumper reaches it; a line 0.9 m off the side is clear with no margin, a conflict with 1.2 m, and the closest approach is the gap less half the width; a building the vehicle enters is distance 0 (bin/test-sweptpath.mjs; the same wall in a real CivilCraft page by tools/sweptpath-engine/browser.mjs)

cases.name: Roundabout geometry and every movement
cases.result: Four legs give 12 movements; the island radius is the inscribed radius less the lane and the apron; a lane wider than the circle, two legs, legs 10 degrees apart and no room for an island are refused; left-hand traffic works (bin/test-sweptpath.mjs)

cases.name: Parking counts the same at any angle
cases.result: A 40 by 20 m lot with 2.5 by 5 m bays and a 6 m aisle holds 32 bays, and the same lot turned 30 degrees holds 32 as well; a boundary of two corners or a bay of no width is refused (bin/test-sweptpath.mjs)

cases.name: CSV quoting and the unverified flag
cases.result: A vehicle name starting with = is quoted so a spreadsheet will not run it, a placeholder vehicle prints NO (placeholder), and an empty run still prints (bin/test-sweptpath.mjs)

cases.name: Citations decide whether a vehicle is checked
cases.result: A vehicle that claims checked but cites nothing is a placeholder and the uncited figures are named; every figure cited plus a source gives checked; one cited figure out of six is still a placeholder; trailer figures must be cited too (bin/test-sweptpath.mjs)

cases.name: Step error bound
cases.result: The run reports a step error in metres, halving the step cuts the bound to about a quarter, and a 40 m arc measures a tightest radius of 40 m (bin/test-sweptpath.mjs)

cases.name: Report page
cases.result: The report text says placeholder, escapes a vehicle name, prints no undefined or NaN, says not set for empty fields, and flows into a PDF through the shared report kit (bin/test-sweptpath.mjs)

cases.name: DXF layers and jump-to
cases.result: The DXF carries its layers, and a problem at station 20 jumps to the place about 20 m along (18.0000 against 18.0000); with no frames it gives no place rather than a made-up one (bin/test-sweptpath.mjs)

cases.name: Envelope on a long alignment
cases.result: A 1.68 km diagonal run keeps a cell of at most 0.1 m, the swath equals the semitrailer width of 2.6 m, mid vertices lie on the band edge within the stated error, and on a short line it agrees with the core grid within 2 percent (bin/test-sweptpath.mjs)
